verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice is a SaaS app that handles customer financial data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for it. The evidence pack only covers invoicing features and general security (PCI-DSS, SSL, 2FA). Nothing documents a policy or control that keeps user data out of AI model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
